facts.fact: The ITU repository lists the Digital Transformation Strategy / Kigali Innovation City as the country's strategy and says the countries it lists have adopted one; no adopting act is named, so this is dated by the repository's 2025 publication year.
The repository gives the time frame of the Digital Transformation Strategy / Kigali Innovation City as 2020 - ongoing.
The repository names the Rwanda Development Board as lead/owner of the Digital Transformation Strategy / Kigali Innovation City.

note: Class is empty: the entry names a Digital Transformation Strategy but describes only skills, R&D, incubation and ICT-hub pillars.
